records.title: Fast-FoundationStereo: Real-Time Zero-Shot Stereo Matching
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.11130. Primary abstract targets real-time stereo matching, not language-model inference.

records.title: Beyond Fixed: Training-Free Variable-Length Denoising for Diffusion Large Language Models
records.reason: Promising inference-work reduction for the emerging diffusion-LM architecture, but evaluation is narrow and primarily reports token utilization rather than end-to-end latency/cost.

records.title: Sparse-vDiT: Unleashing the Power of Sparse Attention to Accelerate Video Diffusion Transformers
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.03065. Primary abstract accelerates video diffusion transformers; the target is video generation rather than LLM inference.

records.title: R1-Searcher++: Incentivizing the Dynamic Knowledge Acquisition of LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17005. Primary abstract focuses on RL-driven dynamic knowledge acquisition and task performance; it does not establish an LLM inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Taming Teacher Forcing for Masked Autoregressive Video Generation
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12389. Primary abstract concerns teacher forcing in masked autoregressive video generation, a training objective rather than LLM inference.
